title: Showcase
description: Explore the template capabilities and the source files that power each demo.

callouts.live: This demo works in development with no extra setup.
callouts.packaged-only: Some behavior is only observable in a packaged build because the OS owns registration flows.
callouts.os-specific: Behavior can vary by platform. The demo shows what this OS exposes right now.

window-state.title: Window state
window-state.summary: Persist and restore window bounds, fullscreen state, and window controls through the Tauri command window API.

titlebar-controls.title: Custom titlebar
titlebar-controls.summary: Renderer-owned window chrome with native minimize, maximize, close, and drag-region behavior.

theme-accent.title: Theme and accent
theme-accent.summary: Live light, dark, system, and accent-color preferences backed by persisted app settings.

i18n-switch.title: Runtime i18n switch
i18n-switch.summary: Change languages at runtime using the shared i18n resource bundle and persisted locale preference.

command-palette.title: Command palette
command-palette.summary: Composable command sources for navigation, settings search, recent files, and app-specific actions.

components-gallery.title: Components gallery
components-gallery.summary: A live developer gallery of reusable UI primitives, common states, and app-level composites.

onboarding-replay.title: Onboarding replay
onboarding-replay.summary: Welcome and onboarding surfaces that can be replayed without resetting the rest of the app.

tray.title: Tray
tray.summary: System tray integration with platform-specific behavior and settings-aware app lifecycle handling.

notifications.title: Native notifications
notifications.summary: Send desktop notifications through a typed Tauri command bridge and Rust notification handler.

global-shortcuts.title: Global shortcuts
global-shortcuts.summary: Register app-level keyboard shortcuts and inspect the active accelerator map from the renderer.

file-dialogs.title: File dialogs and recents
file-dialogs.summary: Open and save files with native dialogs, then surface recent files back through app settings.

deep-links.title: Deep links and app intents
deep-links.summary: Route protocol URLs and startup arguments into typed app intents for renderer navigation.

native-menu.title: Native menu
native-menu.summary: Main-process menus, localized labels, and accelerators wired into app navigation.

secure-storage.title: Secure storage
secure-storage.summary: Store, read, and delete secrets via the Rust secure storage wrapper and typed bridge.

settings-persistence.title: Settings persistence
settings-persistence.summary: Persist app preferences, reset settings, and reflect changes immediately in renderer state.

backup-restore.title: Backup and restore
backup-restore.summary: Export and import local app data with native dialogs and Rust backup helpers.

structured-logs.title: Structured logs and redaction
structured-logs.summary: Main-process logging, redaction helpers, and a renderer log viewer for diagnostics.

diagnostics-report.title: Diagnostics report
diagnostics-report.summary: Generate a support-friendly report with environment, settings, and app health details.

pro.title: Available in Pro
pro.description: These capabilities need a backend or a release pipeline, so they ship in SoarStarter Pro instead of this open-source starter.

email-auth.title: Email sign-in and accounts
email-auth.summary: Email sign-in with password or verification code, profile editing, avatar upload, and keychain session storage.

unified-backend.title: Unified backend
unified-backend.summary: Share accounts, data, and billing with the SoarStarter web app through one versioned API, called from Rust.

synced-data.title: Synced data example
synced-data.summary: A todos CRUD sample that runs against Supabase or the unified backend, with user-scoped query invalidation.

checkout.title: Checkout and subscriptions
checkout.summary: Creem checkout and customer portal, with subscription state kept in sync.

license-keys.title: License key activation
license-keys.summary: Optional license-key activation layered on top of the subscription entitlements.

feature-gates.title: Feature gates
feature-gates.summary: Reusable entitlement checks and UI gates for free, pro, and lifetime plans.

auto-updates.title: Auto-updates and release pipeline
auto-updates.summary: Signed, notarized releases with a self-hosted update feed, download progress, and install and restart.

error-reporting.title: Error reporting
error-reporting.summary: Opt-in Sentry reporting for Rust panics and webview errors, with redacted context.

analytics.title: Product analytics
analytics.summary: An opt-in analytics slot that stays inert until an endpoint and user consent exist.
